```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
game_id <- 401856883
# The game's kickoff date from the games table (plays carry no date).
game_date <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT startDate FROM games WHERE id = ?",
  params = list(as.integer(game_id))
)$startDate |>
  substr(1, 10) |>
  as.Date() |>
  format("%B %d, %Y")
teams <- collect(tbl(con, "teams"))
```

```{r}
#| label: game-epa
# The game's scrimmage plays, each with its CFBD PPA (the EPA on these cards),
# then the running total per offense in game order. Georgia is listed first.
plays <- game_plays(con, game_id)
home <- plays$home[1]
away <- plays$away[1]
team_levels <- c(home, away)
matchup <- paste0(home, " vs ", away, ", ", game_date)
run <- game_running(game_scrimmage(plays)) |>
  mutate(
    offense = factor(offense, team_levels),
    tip = paste0(
      "<b>",
      offense,
      "</b><br>",
      playText,
      "<br>Play EPA: ",
      round(ppa, 2),
      "<br>Running total: ",
      round(cum_ppa, 1)
    )
  )
tot <- run |>
  summarise(plays = n(), per_play = mean(ppa), .by = offense)
mz_low <- run |>
  filter(offense == away) |>
  slice_min(cum_ppa, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
p <- ggplot(run, aes(game_min, cum_ppa, color = offense)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(15, 30, 45), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 1.2) +
  annotate(
    "point",
    x = mz_low$game_min,
    y = mz_low$cum_ppa,
    shape = 4,
    size = 4,
    stroke = 1.2
  ) +
  annotate(
    "label",
    x = mz_low$game_min + 2,
    y = mz_low$cum_ppa - 3,
    label = paste0(away, " low: ", round(mz_low$cum_ppa, 1)),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 6,
    fill = "white",
    label.size = 0
  ) +
  scale_color_team(teams, name = "Offense") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 15, 30, 45, 60), limits = c(0, 60)) +
  labs(
    title = "Running total of EPA by offense",
    subtitle = paste0(
      matchup,
      "; scrimmage plays with an EPA, by game minute; dashed lines mark quarter breaks"
    ),
    x = "Game minutes elapsed",
    y = "Cumulative EPA",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "game-epa-running-total", release = release)
card_interactive(
  p +
    geom_point_interactive(
      data = run,
      aes(game_min, cum_ppa, color = offense, tooltip = tip, data_id = id),
      size = 2
    )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: table
tot |>
  transmute(
    Offense = as.character(offense),
    Plays = plays,
    `EPA per play` = round(per_play, 2)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Offense", "Plays", "EPA per play"),
    caption = paste0(
      "Plays and average EPA per play for each offense over the ",
      sum(tot$plays),
      " scrimmage plays that carry an EPA."
    )
  )
```
